newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil sells stake in Norway supply base.
newsitem.headline: Statoil sells stake in Norway supply base.

text.p: Den Norske Stats Oljeselskap ASA said on Tuesday it had made a preliminary agreement to sell a 50 percent holding in a Norwegian offshore supply base to Aker Maritime ASA.
Aker subsidiary Aker Base will take over Statoil's share in the Coast Centre Base (CCB) at Aagotnes near Bergen from February 1, 1997, Statoil said in a statement.
Aker Base will jointly own the facility with Bernhard Larsen Holding A/S.

Statoil said it was dependent on a well-organised supply service to its North Sea oil and gas platforms. Aker Maritime's extensive experience would be useful in further development of a solid base operation, the state oil company said.
A final agreement should be in place in January, Statoil said.
